SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT NCESSchool, 
           SUM(NumGE1500) AS TotalGE1500, 
           SUM(NumTstTakr) AS TotalTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY NCESSchool
) ss ON s.NCESSchool = ss.NCESSchool
ORDER BY CAST(ss.TotalGE1500 AS REAL) / ss.TotalTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT NCESSchool, 
           CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr AS ExcellenceRate
    FROM satscores
) ss ON s.NCESSchool = ss.NCESSchool
ORDER BY ss.ExcellenceRate DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT NCESSchool,
           NumGE1500,
           NumTstTakr,
           (CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr) AS ExcellenceRate
    FROM satscores
) sat ON s.NCESSchool = sat.NCESSchool
ORDER BY sat.ExcellenceRate DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS sat_excellence_rate
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) sub ON s.CDSCode = sub.cds
ORDER BY sub.sat_excellence_rate DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
    ORDER BY avg_sat_score DESC
    LIMIT 3
) t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds;

SELECT 
    s.Phone,
    AVG(sats.AvgScrMath + sats.AvgScrRead + sats.AvgScrWrite) AS SAT_Excellence_Rate
FROM 
    satscores sats
JOIN 
    schools s ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
GROUP BY 
    s.CDSCode
ORDER BY 
    SAT_Excellence_Rate DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY CDSCode
    ORDER BY avg_sat_score DESC
    LIMIT 3
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, AVG(NumGE1500) AS AvgSATExcellenceRate
    FROM frpm
    GROUP BY CDSCode
    ORDER BY AvgSATExcellenceRate DESC
    LIMIT 3
) f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode;

SELECT Phone 
FROM schools 
WHERE NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT NCESSchool 
    FROM schools 
    ORDER BY CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr DESC 
    LIMIT 3
);

SELECT Phone 
FROM schools 
WHERE NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT NCESSchool 
    FROM schools 
    ORDER BY CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr DESC 
    LIMIT 3
);

SELECT Phone 
FROM schools 
WHERE NCESSchool IN (
    SELECT NCESSchool 
    FROM satscores 
    GROUP BY NCESSchool 
    ORDER BY SUM(NumGE1500) / SUM(NumTstTakr) DESC 
    LIMIT 3
);

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.School = ss.sname
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY (ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) / 3 DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.NCESSchool, s.Phone
ORDER BY AVG(ss.NumGE1500) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY AVG(ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.School Type = 'High Schools (Public)'
ORDER BY f.Percent (%) Eligible FRPM DESC
LIMIT 3;
